classificationAnchorPolicy: Statuses describe the repository and private specification state at the pre-deliverable audit anchor. The audit-created, unregistered gap plan does not retroactively promote an E capability to D.

dimensionLegend.yes: Established for the capability as named
dimensionLegend.partial: Established only for a narrower or defective subset

summary.productReality: provider-specific bounded candidate built on a fixture-oriented reference scaffold
summary.referenceRuntime: partial fixture scaffold, not a composed reference runtime

currentCandidate.traceabilityNote: candidate-manifest.json labels LS-DEC-013 as perceptual acceptance, but the current private decision register defines LS-DEC-013 as production retention, deletion, key custody, backup, and recovery

capabilities.reality: Executable library and unit tests exist, but no server or client subscribes to it.
In-memory renderer fixture with manually supplied semantic data.
Static responsive Atlas semantic-state page. It has no data source and is not served by Lifestream.

capabilities.capability: Actual character or avatar asset and renderer
capabilities.reality: No avatar media, canvas, video, character renderer, or production rendering engine was found.
Configuration has a renderer string, but no factory or runtime composition exists.

capabilities.capability: Visible idle, listening, thinking, speaking, interrupted, warning, emergency, and error behavior
capabilities.reality: The fixture page is frozen at listening/conversing and contains only a few alternate text summaries; no live state lifecycle exists.

capabilities.capability: Shared expression-decision correlation between voice and visuals
capabilities.reality: Correlation can be manually populated in fixture tests. SemanticState lacks decision identity and no live renderer consumes the voice decision.
No audio-to-animation or lip-sync implementation exists.
SemanticState infrastructure can carry attention and attentionTargetRef, but Presence renders only a static attention word and no renderer produces visual gaze behavior.
No conversation transcript, caption stream, text input, or response view exists.
No device permission, mute, input, output, or level controls exist.
Only static browser pages exist.
A responsive page is not a mobile companion application.
Endpoint type scaffolding is not a client.
No microphone-to-speaker endpoint application exists.

capabilities.capability: Setup, settings, and ordinary status UX
capabilities.reality: No ordinary-user configuration or truthful status interface exists.
A hard-coded Atlas request is served, but approve and deny only mutate the DOM while claiming server recording.

capabilities.capability: Stable persisted assistantId and profile rows
capabilities.reality: The isolated SQLite profile repository persists rows, but the server never opens it and it is not exported from the package.

capabilities.capability: Immutable profile revisions and atomic activation
capabilities.reality: CAS-like activation exists, but direct invalid active inserts bypass activation and superseded rows deserialize as active after restart.

capabilities.capability: Deterministic Core Persona and Adaptive Persona projection
capabilities.reality: A one-line serializer exists, is not called, and omits active values, confidence, review, and mode constraints.
A narrow helper checks a subset of bounds; durable policy, evidence independence, cumulative limits, and active-profile binding are absent.
Shallow helpers and maps accept a forbidden changeCorePersona proposal; no durable journal or supported reversal journey exists.

No authoritative Tifa profile exists. Public matches are exclusions/test values; private matches are voice fixtures and provider-neutral contract prose, while authored persona fixtures say Example Assistant.

capabilities.capability: Canonical identity, values, relationship, privacy, behavior, voice, and protected self-facts
capabilities.reality: The generic profile schema covers part of the structure; privacy posture, protected self-facts, mode rules, and a Tifa instance are absent.

capabilities.capability: Approved initial adaptive dimensions and baselines
capabilities.reality: Only generic validation fixtures exist; none is an approved Tifa baseline.
Specification prose exists; the profile schema and prompt runtime do not implement it.

capabilities.capability: Human inspect, create, compare, activate, and reverse profile workflow
capabilities.reality: Immutable profile and activation rules exist, but the complete Human inspection/create/compare/activate/reverse journey is neither sufficiently specified nor implemented.

capabilities.capability: Trace correlation to active profile and adaptation revisions
capabilities.reality: Schemas include a profile revision field, but no composed runtime emits it and adaptation revision is absent.

capabilities.capability: Real-model behavioral acceptance for the active profile
capabilities.reality: There is no real inference provider or authored Tifa profile to test.

capabilities.capability: SQLite canonical memory records and append-only lifecycle events
capabilities.reality: A migration and contracts exist, but MemoryRepository is an in-memory Map and the migration is omitted from Database.migrate.
The full server restart journey creates no database and returns no answer; a new Map repository is empty.

capabilities.capability: Correction, contradiction, supersession, invalidation, and reversal
capabilities.reality: Lifecycle contracts exist; no repository or user path applies them.
Provider/schema intent exists without an implementation or operator command.

capabilities.capability: Backup and restore of complete application memory
capabilities.reality: A test-only generic SQLite copy and integrity rehearsal preserves one synthetic table, not Lifestream identity, memory, artifacts, or secrets.

capabilities.capability: Persisted PreparedContext views and source-aware invalidation
capabilities.reality: Schema and omitted migration exist; runtime cache is a Map without persistence or provider-driven invalidation.

capabilities.capability: Healthy active AssistantMemoryProvider in a runnable profile
capabilities.reality: The server labels memory healthy from a string but instantiates no provider.
Constructor-seeded case-insensitive substring matching works; paraphrase fails and reinforcement is a no-op.

capabilities.capability: Semantic, episodic, entity, and fact retrieval
capabilities.reality: No embeddings, semantic index, entity model, or episodic retrieval implementation exists.

capabilities.capability: Hindsight or another non-fixture memory adapter
capabilities.reality: Hindsight is a proposed reference choice only; no package, dependency, configuration, or adapter exists.
Only schema and trace vocabulary exist; no cognition call site extracts candidates.

capabilities.capability: Validation and admission of memory candidates
capabilities.reality: Canonical envelopes exist; no runtime path validates, quarantines, admits, or rejects candidates.

capabilities.capability: Useful retrieval ranking and token budgeting
capabilities.reality: A generic sort-and-limit helper is not semantic ranking or token-budgeted prompt selection.
Callback-driven test helpers and Map repositories exist; forbidden Core Persona mutation passes and no real analysis or durable recovery exists.

capabilities.capability: Memory review, correction, deletion, or invalidation UX
capabilities.reality: Lifecycle review/correction semantics exist, but the complete Human review/correction/deletion-or-invalidation UX is neither sufficiently specified nor implemented.

capabilities.capability: Sensitivity, privacy, retention, and provenance enforcement
capabilities.reality: Rich fields and policy prose exist, but the Map accepts arbitrary records and no application policy or inspection path enforces them.
Configuration strings exist; the server constructs no provider and does not load profile files.
The fixture concatenates supplied section content and is exercised only by tests.
Schemas and private specification define it, but runtime exposes arbitrary sections and has no builder, order, digest, sources, token counts, or redaction enforcement.

capabilities.capability: Real SGLang or OpenAI-compatible inference adapter
capabilities.reality: Only a differently named port and fixture exist; there is no network adapter.

capabilities.capability: Selected real model and immutable model revision
capabilities.reality: Standard inference runtime, model, quantization, context, and KV-cache policy remain open.
The only interaction route ignores its body and returns static acceptance; the canonical message route is 404.

capabilities.capability: Harmless structured tool or capability selection through a real model
capabilities.reality: Fixture capability policy tests exist, but no model, message loop, or user journey selects and invokes a capability.
Canonical schema exists; runtime accepts arbitrary trusted flags and blindly concatenates content.
Audio input types exist, but no endpoint captures a microphone.
No resampler exists; a focused probe found a 48 kHz Vox frame relabeled as 16 kHz.
Specified for endpoint ownership; no implementation exists.

Specified for endpoint ownership; no implementation exists.
The NeMo request carries an endpointing option, but no VAD observation is surfaced or consumed.
Synthetic committed events drive fixture tests; no endpoint/VAD policy commits a real user turn.

A buildable adapter and manifest pin the runtime/model, with one historical development-host probe. No runnable Lifestream profile composes it, and the external NeMo service is not packaged or launched by the repository.
A unit-tested segmenter exists, but VoicePipeline does not use it and repeats segment-0 for every inference chunk.
Operator-provisioned WSL development-host evidence exists for the adapter and sidecar. It is not composed, release-packaged, or Tifa-voice accepted.
The only bundle is purpose-generated fixture-voice-design with no reference audio; the adapter ignores request.voiceProfile.
The sink is an in-memory bounded array used by tests, not an audio device.

capabilities.capability: Audible physical or browser speaker output
capabilities.reality: No Web Audio, native device, or OS playback implementation exists.
Tests timestamp first fixture sink write or provider PCM, not an audible speaker sample. Fixture PCM byte length is internally inconsistent.

capabilities.capability: Barge-in stops playback and fences late audio
capabilities.reality: A separate controller and fixture sink have unit tests, but VoicePipeline never integrates them and cannot listen during playback.
Only a synthetic fixture pipeline exists. No runnable profile connects capture, NeMo, real inference, Vox, and audible playback.
Pipeline accepts an injected decision or manufactures a neutral default; no cognition path derives one.

capabilities.capability: Correct audio format and byte-count integrity across stages
capabilities.reality: NeMo requires 16 kHz, Vox emits 48 kHz, no resampler exists, Vox relabels frames, and fixture PCM sampleCount does not match decoded bytes.
Contracts and mapping helpers exist; contract validation does not prove a connected gateway.

capabilities.capability: Live-capable PWCE HTTP and SSE client
capabilities.reality: The client implements operations and SSE parsing, but it is not a workspace package or runtime dependency and most operations are mock-tested.
The client expects a pinned profile/digest and one receipt records narrow development integration, but no packaged or selected bundle is part of Lifestream startup.

capabilities.capability: Successful live context and capability integration
capabilities.reality: Narrow isolated gateway access was recorded, but complete operations use mocks and no Lifestream cognition journey consumes them.

capabilities.capability: Safe read-only world question end to end
capabilities.reality: No real inference/message loop or configured PWCE provider exposes a user journey.
Raw SSE parsing is mock-tested; no cache or policy consumer performs reevaluation.

capabilities.capability: Typed proactive urgent-attention event and interruption seam
capabilities.reality: No urgent event type, mapping, suitability gate, interruption policy, or expressive delivery handler exists. Invalidation is not an alarm.

capabilities.capability: Truthful PWCE outage degradation preserving standalone identity and memory
capabilities.reality: Required behavior is specified but no standalone identity/memory runtime or PWCE composition exists.
Package metadata exists, but the frozen lock lacks the NeMo workspace importer and PWCE has no package manifest.

capabilities.capability: Configure non-secret values and secret references
capabilities.reality: A config type and two fixture JSON files exist, but the CLI never loads them and accepts only PORT.

capabilities.capability: One documented command starts server and required sidecars
capabilities.reality: Root has no start script or application Compose/runbook. Server package start requires a prior build and starts no sidecars.

capabilities.capability: Useful and truthful provider, memory, profile, and degraded status
capabilities.reality: A health endpoint exists, but it reports all configured names healthy without instantiation; its digest strips nested provider and storage values.

capabilities.capability: Configure real inference, memory, STT, TTS, renderer, and PWCE providers
capabilities.reality: Only test and local-dev profiles exist; both name fixtures, neither is loaded, and no real provider factory exists.

capabilities.capability: Create or activate an Assistant profile and configure a voice profile
capabilities.reality: Low-level profile rows and a fixture voice bundle exist, but no supported workflow connects them.

capabilities.capability: Start a text or voice conversation
capabilities.reality: Canonical message/audio routes are schema-only and return 404; the non-versioned interaction route is a static 202.

capabilities.capability: Stop and restart without losing intended state
capabilities.reality: Graceful server lifecycle, a file-backed SQLite wrapper, and isolated profile/rehearsal restart checks exist separately. The server never composes that database, so the complete controlled restart journey created no database file.

capabilities.capability: Safely enter and leave AI Mode and Game Mode
capabilities.reality: Only an execution note references the modes; no canonical state machine, command, or lifecycle implementation exists in this repository.
Only test-callable fixture helpers exist; there is no command, manifest covering application state/artifacts, rollback UI, or secret rebind journey.
Vox source lock is blocked-before-build, post-build attestation is not-built, and no complete application artifact exists.
